compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: On approval, accepted additions written to repo-root DESIGN.md via flock-serialized write
- dd-6: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/write-design-md-additions.sh: accepts JSON payload on stdin, validates fields, flock-serialized append to DESIGN.md. Handles: missing DESIGN.md (create it), idempotent append (check for existing section before appending), invalid payload (exit non-zero).

chmod +x immediately.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Script exists and is executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/write-design-md-additions.sh
- [ ] Idempotent: duplicate invocations do not create duplicate sections — Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-write-design-md-additions.sh
- [ ] Creates DESIGN.md when absent — Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-write-design-md-additions.sh
- [ ] Rejects empty/invalid payload (exit non-zero) — Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-write-design-md-additions.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker — Verify: grep '\[test_write_design_md_additions\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
